blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — Commuters in South Cotabato are feeling the pinch of higher public transport fares that took effect on Monday, forcing some to adjust their daily budgets as drivers say the increase barely covers rising operating costs. Among them is Tessie Larroza, a resident of Sto. Niño, South Cotabato, who works in Koronadal City and regularly travels between her hometown and the city for work. “We already have a lot of expenses, and now transportation fares increase, too,” Larroza said.
